explanation.headline: Lansoprazole is not on FDA's shortage list; Corvale East has 19 days on hand and Corvale General has 27.7 days on hand

sentences.text: FDA's drug shortage list does not include lansoprazole as of 2026-10-21.
Corvale East holds 182 capsules of the 30 mg presentation with a daily use of 9.6, providing 19 days on hand.
Corvale General holds 255 capsules of the 30 mg presentation with a daily use of 9.2, providing 27.7 days on hand.
The top-ranked purchasing option is Camber Pharmaceuticals, Inc., which is not on FDA's shortage list and uses Hetero Labs Limited Unit III, last inspected VAI on 2023-07-21.
The current label for the product in use names A-S Medication Solutions as the registered plant, last inspected VAI on 2026-08-12.
A-S Medication Solutions received a Warning Letter on 2017-06-05 and its most recent inspection was classified VAI on 2026-08-12.
Buyers should verify that the Camber supply chain remains clear and monitor the A-S Medication Solutions plant for any future regulatory actions.
